details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries (snapshot GET at lines 278-281) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The snapshot GET via curl_gh_api has no --max-time, so a stalled connection can hang cleanup far beyond the 10s bound applied to the other calls.
  WHY: curl_gh_api retries up to 5 times with rate-limit sleeps up to 600s, so the step can block until the job timeout. Severity: MAJOR from gemini and minimax, a hardening suggestion from glm.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:tg_cleanup_phase_msgs, tg_cleanup_msgs (DELETE logic) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The tracking comment is DELETEd by ID with no re-validation against the snapshot, so a tg_store_* PATCH landing in between orphans the new ID.
  WHY: The bot treats the tracking comment as gone and never deletes the orphaned message. Another reviewer (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5) judged this race pre-existing.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Message IDs are taken from the comment body without any author check, so any commenter can inject markers and make the bot delete messages in the admin chat.
  WHY: Gemini rated this BLOCKER but noted it is pre-existing (SEC-001). Other reviewers also noted it as pre-existing and not introduced here.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded max_pages=100 limit aborts cleanup if an issue exceeds it.
  WHY: The issue would be left permanently uncleaned. Gemini rated this NIT.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:_tg_delete_msg_checked (lines 238-241) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The function returns 0 when TG_BOT_SECRET or the chat ID is missing, so cleanup deletes the GitHub tracking comment.
  WHY: The Telegram messages then remain with no markers left. Other reviewers say this is unreachable from the cleanup paths and is pinned by test_missing_telegram_secret_still_deletes_comments.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:retain path in tg_cleanup_phase_msgs / tg_cleanup_msgs (lines 554-559, 631-636) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A kept tracking comment retains IDs that were already deleted, so each retry repeats deleteMessage calls for them.
  WHY: This adds redundant Telegram API calls until the transient failure clears. The cost is bounded and the behavior is as the issue requests (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5).
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:_tg_delete_msg_checked (ok == false branch, around lines 245-247) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: An HTTP 401 with ok:false (revoked token) is classified as permanent, so the tracking comment is deleted and its IDs are lost.
  WHY: This is a hardening suggestion with risk score 2. The issue lists .ok == false as done.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Every outbound call in the cleanup path should be time-bounded (Telegram delete calls and comment DELETEs now time out after 10 seconds)
  expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh, curl_gh_api call in _tg_snapshot_tracking_entries
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The snapshot GET in _tg_snapshot_tracking_entries has no --max-time, although the GitHub DELETE calls and Telegram calls have one.
- requirement: Add a new internal helper with a unique name (check that the name is not already used, for example _tg_delete_msg_checked)
  expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The helper exists with the expected name, so the reviewer found no concrete gap (NIT).
- requirement: If any page read fails, emit the existing ::warning:: and abort the cleanup without deleting anything from a partial snapshot
  expected_change_site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh: _tg_snapshot_tracking_entries
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer states the requirement is satisfied (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:_tg_delete_msg_checked (ok == false branch, around lines 245-247) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: An HTTP 401 with ok:false (revoked token) is classified as permanent, so the tracking comment is deleted and its IDs are lost. This is a hardening suggestion, not a defect.
  WHY: The issue lists .ok == false as done. Suggested fix: return 1 on HTTP 401 (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
- All other categories: NONE.
- Missing-context notes: the pre-push failure in tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py could not be tied to a changed line. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure is external ("Prompt too big"). A noexec tmp_path can make the test harness exit 126.

- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:278-281 (_tg_snapshot_tracking_entries) | confidence=none stated
  PROBLEM: This is a hardening suggestion: the snapshot GET has no --max-time, and curl_gh_api retries up to 5 times with sleeps up to 600s. Suggested fix: add --max-time 30 (1 line).
  WHY: The cleanup step can stall far longer than the 10s bound applied elsewhere.

  WHY: Retries would then make fewer calls. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
